content.text:
## PR #2241: centralize metadata resolution

Reviewing `refactor-git-metadata-owner` against `main@fce049c`: 2 commits, 7 files changed. Intent context was available from 2 Entire checkpoints.

### Findings

## `cmd/entire/cli/gitrepo/metadata.go`

High: A symlinked registration can physically escape `CommonDir/worktrees`.

At [metadata.go:146](/Users/muskanpaliwal/Work/open-source/entire/cli/refactor-git-metadata-owner/cmd/entire/cli/gitrepo/metadata.go:146), validation first compares the lexical parent of `gitDirPath` with `CommonDir/worktrees`. Consider:

```text
<common>/worktrees/wt -> /tmp/planted-registration
```

If the target contains a `commondir` pointing back to `<common>`, the lexical parent comparison succeeds. `EvalSymlinks` is skipped, so the resolver returns `WorktreeID="wt"` even though the physical Git directory is outside the registration root.

Intent: Physical aliases are accepted only when they resolve to an immediate child of `CommonDir/worktrees`.

Actual: A symlink outside the root pointing inward is handled, but the inverse—an entry inside the root pointing outward—is accepted.

Fix: Resolve `gitDirPath` physically before every immediate-child check and derive `WorktreeID` from that physical registration path. Add a negative fixture for “symlink inside registration root points outside,” retaining the existing outside-alias-to-inside positive control.

## `cmd/entire/cli/gitrepo/metadata_guard_test.go`

Medium: The ownership guard still has ordinary bypasses.

At [metadata_guard_test.go:81](/Users/muskanpaliwal/Work/open-source/entire/cli/refactor-git-metadata-owner/cmd/entire/cli/gitrepo/metadata_guard_test.go:81), only package-level `.git` identifiers are collected. This passes undetected:

```go
func inspect(root *os.Root) {
    name := ".git"
    _, _ = root.Lstat(name)
}
```

The call contains no literal, and `root` is not recognized as an imported filesystem package. A direct `ResolveDotGitPath(...)` call from another file in package `gitrepo` also escapes because [isLegacyMetadataResolverCall](/Users/muskanpaliwal/Work/open-source/entire/cli/refactor-git-metadata-owner/cmd/entire/cli/gitrepo/metadata_guard_test.go:316) recognizes unqualified calls only for dot imports.

Intent: Prevent new independent metadata traversal and new uses of the retained legacy resolvers.

Fix: Track local string aliases or type-check rooted filesystem receivers, and recognize unqualified legacy calls when scanning package `gitrepo`. Add positive controls for both cases.

### Correctness model

- Read owner: `ResolveWorktreeMetadata`.
- Write owner: unchanged `OpenPath` callers; the resolver itself is read-only.
- Interruption behavior: no durable state is changed, so retry is safe.
- Cleanup: repository storage is closed on failed opens.
- Unproven contract: physical registration containment and complete guard enforcement.

### Prior reviews

No prior GitHub reviews or inline comments. The checkpoint history showed earlier internal findings about symlink aliases and guard coverage; this review found remaining inverse/bypass cases.

### Verification

- `go test ./cmd/entire/cli/gitrepo`: passed
- `mise run lint`: passed, 0 issues
- `git diff --check`: passed
- Worktree: clean

### Verdict

Request changes.
